name: iptvnator-android
description: Experimental Capacitor wrapper of the IPTVnator TV client for Android TV

scripts.sync:web: rm -rf www && cp -R ../iptvnator/dist/apps/tv www && cp shell/android-shim.js www/ && sed -i '' -e 's|content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"|content="width=1920"|' -e 's|<title>|<script src="./android-shim.js"></script><title>|' www/index.html
scripts.sync: npm run sync:web && cap sync android
scripts.build:apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug -q
